bank_soal.teks_pertanyaan:
Teks untuk soal nomor 4 dan 5!

"Hello class!
How are you doing today? I hope all of you feel great today.
Allow me to introduce myself. My name is Nurul Hayati. You can call me Ms. Hayati. I'm 37 years old, and English is my subject.
I live in Bukit Cendana no. 15, Semarang with my husband and daughter. I grew up here.
My hobby is baking cake and pastry. I also love cycling. I go to school by bicycle every day.
That's all about me. Nice to meet you, class!"

What does Ms. Hayati teach?
Which statements are CORRECT based on the text?
pilihan_jawaban: A. Ms. Hayati is 37 years old.
B. Her hobbies are baking cake, pastry, and cycling.
D. She goes to school by car every day.

bank_soal.teks_pertanyaan: Put a check mark in the correct column.
pernyataan: 1. Ms. Hayati is 37 years old and teaches English.
2. Ms. Hayati goes to school by motorcycle every day.
3. She lives in Bukit Cendana No. 15, Semarang.

bank_soal.teks_pertanyaan:
Read the story below!

Diva really loves singing. She can sing any genre of music; she can even do rap. Her hobby is just like Mr. Lukman, her father.

Diva has a favorite singer, Selena Gomez. She listens to her music songs every weekend. After a while, she memorized the songs. Her parents gave her many Selena Gomez albums on every birthday. They even bought her a good microphone to sing.

To channel her hobby, Diva joined a singing course with a famous vocal trainer in Bandung. She met her best friend, Dewi, there.

Diva has often participated in singing competitions since she was 5 years old. Her parents and coach are very supportive of her because of her beautiful voice.

What did Diva get from her parents for her hobby?
What does Diva like to do as her hobby?
pilihan_jawaban: A. She writes her own songs.
C. She takes courses and joins competitions.
D. She listens to Selena's songs every weekend.

Determine whether each statement below is True (B) or False (S) based on the story!
pernyataan: 1. Diva can only sing pop songs.
2. Diva listens to Selena Gomez's songs every weekend.
3. Diva joined a singing course in Bandung.
